items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 7 at 9:02PM EDT until September 8 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT... Strong east to west longshore current for south-facing
beaches. Strong north to south longshore current for east-facing
beaches. There is also a Moderate Risk of rip currents expected
for Horry County beaches.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Coastal Brunswick County. In South
Carolina, Coastal Horry County.

* WHEN...From 6 AM EDT Tuesday through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Longshore currents can sweep swimmers and surfers
into rip currents, piers, jetties, and other hazardous areas.
It may sweep swimmers off their feet, making it difficult to
return to shore.
items.instruction:
Caution should be used when in or near the water. Check with
lifeguards before entering the ocean for possible hazards you may
be swept into.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 7 at 2:21PM EDT until September 8 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina and Northeast South Carolina
coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
